title: Japan Raises Residency Fees 2,000 Percent Amid ‘Anxiety’ Over Foreigners
summary_full: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is making it harder for immigrants to stay in the country. Critics say she is hurting Japan’s ability to address labor shortages.
